name: Goodreads: Similar Books (Recommendations)
summary: Given a Goodreads book, return the full 'Readers also enjoyed' recommendation list with title, author, average rating, ratings count, and URL.
description: Opens a book page, follows its /book/similar/<work_id> link as a person would, and reads the server-rendered .responsiveBook entries into a clean recommendation list. This is the read-only proxy for Goodreads recommendations seeded from a book you like (personalized account recommendations require login). Feed any book_url back into goodreads/book for details.

book_url.description: Full Goodreads book URL whose recommendations you want, e.g. https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/29993569-raising-a-secure-child. Query strings and #anchors are ignored.

steps.name: Navigate to the seed book page
Wait for book chrome / similar link

inputs.script: const norm=(s)=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const cleanPath=(h)=>{const m=(h||'').match(/\/book\/show\/[^?#]+/);return m?m[0]:'';};const simHref=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(`a[href*='/book/similar/']`)).map(a=>a.getAttribute('href')).find(Boolean);if(!simHref)throw new Error('this book page has no Readers also enjoyed link');const seed={path:cleanPath(location.pathname),title:norm(document.querySelector(`h1[data-testid='bookTitle']`)?.textContent)||norm(document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent)};sessionStorage.setItem('__rzn_goodreads_seed',JSON.stringify(seed));const target=new URL(simHref,location.origin).toString();setTimeout(()=>location.assign(target),0);return {target};

steps.name: Open the Readers also enjoyed page, as clicking its link would
Read the recommendations the page shows

inputs.script: const norm=(s)=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const origin=location.origin;const cleanPath=(h)=>{const m=(h||'').match(/\/book\/show\/[^?#]+/);return m?m[0]:'';};let seed={};try{seed=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('__rzn_goodreads_seed')||'{}')}catch{}const out=[];const seen=new Set();for(const it of document.querySelectorAll('.responsiveBook')){const a=it.querySelector(`a[href*='/book/show/']`);if(!a)continue;const p=cleanPath(a.getAttribute('href'));if(!p||p===seed.path||seen.has(p))continue;const img=it.querySelector('img');const title=(img?norm(img.getAttribute('alt')):'')||'';const author=norm(it.querySelector(`a[href*='/author/show/']`)?.textContent);const t=norm(it.textContent);const rm=t.match(/([0-9.]+)\s*avg\.?\s*rating/i);const cm=t.match(/avg\.?\s*rating[^0-9]*([0-9.,k]+)\s*ratings?/i);seen.add(p);out.push({title:title||'N/A',author:author||'N/A',avg_rating:rm?rm[1]:'N/A',ratings_count:cm?cm[1].replace(/,/g,''):'N/A',book_url:origin+p});}return {seed_title:seed.title||'N/A',similar_url:(origin+location.pathname).replace(/[?#].*$/,''),count:out.length,recommendations:out};

help.summary: Full 'Readers also enjoyed' recommendation list for a Goodreads book.

parameters.book_url: Full Goodreads /book/show/ URL to seed recommendations from.

examples.description: Get recommendations seeded from a book

returns: Object: { seed_title, similar_url, count, recommendations: [{ title, author, avg_rating, ratings_count, book_url }] }.
notes: Reads the book page, then opens its /book/similar/<work_id> page (server-rendered) and parses .responsiveBook entries; no request of its own. A book page without that link is an error.
This is the seeded-by-a-book recommendation surface; account-personalized recommendations on /recommendations require a logged-in Goodreads session and are not covered here.
ratings_count may be a compact form like '47.1k' as Goodreads renders it on the similar page.
